explication_en: The TrueNASPlugin.pm plugin reads the configuration from storage.cfg.example, authenticates via lib/TrueNAS/SCRAM.pm and goes through the broker in tools/truenas-plugin-broker launched by a systemd service. The packaging (build-deb.sh, install.sh) and the test suites under t/ complete the repository.
